## Activity

During April 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 102 captures. This represents the site’s total capture activity for the month. The activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes and supports routine monitoring of the service delivered at the centre.

## Image quality

Of the 102 captures, 7 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.9%. These images could not be used for a grading decision and are included in the site’s monthly image-quality review. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when monitoring performance and identifying any need for local follow-up.

## Grading

A total of 15 captures were graded as referable. The median lag was 2. This is the median time between capture and grading for the month. Together, the referable result and the median lag provide a summary of the month’s grading activity at Hill Counties Health Centre. Overall, the figures show the volume reviewed, the proportion recorded as ungradable, and the number requiring referral.
